howto.goal: Finish with more of your discs on the board than the other side.
howto.setup: An 8 by 8 board with four discs in the middle: two of each colour. White moves first.

sections.title: Flipping
sections.text: Place a disc so it traps a line of the other colour between two of yours. That whole line flips to your colour.

sections.title: Legal moves only
sections.text: A move must flip at least one disc. If you have no legal move, your turn is skipped.

sections.title: The end
sections.text: The game ends when neither side can move. The side with more discs wins.

controls: Click an empty square to place a disc.
Squares that would flip something are the only legal ones.
Watch the corners: a corner disc can never be flipped.

frames.say: Place here to trap a line.
The trapped disc flips to your colour.
A corner can never be taken back.

demo.intro: A short computer game showing how a flip works.

lines.say: Four discs in the middle. White moves first.
White places beside the black discs and flips one.
Black flips that line back to black.
White takes a square on the other side.
Black flips a line from below. Every move changes the count.

demo.outro: Early on, giving away discs can be good: it limits your opponent's legal moves.

steps.say: Click a square that traps a line of the other colour.
Corners can never be flipped, so work toward them.
Avoid giving the other side a corner.
If you have no legal move the turn passes — that is normal.
